system.description:
An extremely rare and costly injectable, rumoured to be refined from the spinal fluid of spellcasters, that suppresses magical ability; long-term use makes subjects docile and eventually schizophrenic.

For one day the target takes -1k1 on all spellcasting rolls and their caster level is lowered by 1.
system.effectText: -1k1 spellcasting and caster level -1 for one day.
